_meta.description: Baseline freeze for BGC-detection architecture comparison. Rows = methods, columns = datasets. Hand-consolidated from the source files listed in `_sources`. Do not edit numbers here without updating source artifacts and REGRESSION_LEDGER.md in lockstep.
_meta.prior_null_result: Zero-shot Evo2 LL (8 scoring variants, w=16384/s=8192) produces best 9g dedup_F1=0.1296 -- 3.8x worse than v4.1-mainline. Pure LL signal rejected. See experiments/evo2_first_principles/9g_eval_ll_zscore_pos/sweep_summary.json.

v4_1_hysteresis.method: v4.1 multi-scale ensemble (hysteresis decoder, primary w=8192 + short w=4096, frozen OP)

oer004256_ge10kb._as_overlap_rate_note: README headline reports AS-recall=12% (fraction of antiSMASH regions hit by v4.1). 'as_overlap_count' 239/254 is the inverse direction (v4.1 regions that overlap any antiSMASH). Both are preserved here; AS-recall is the comparable metric vs v4.1-learned.

per_type_count._caveat: antiSMASH coverage at time of wrap_up was partial (1 of 7 samples: OER00425669 part00+part01). Per-type count is from v4.1 internal typing, not from antiSMASH-matched subset.

v4_1_learned.method: v4.1 multi-scale + learned 1D CNN decoder (c00 CNN-3L hidden=32 BCE, ~50K params; primary thr=0.95, short thr=0.98)

nine_genome.prior_0_461_note: Earlier 0.461 number in docs/REGRESSION_LEDGER.md #16 / full_pipeline_report.md is from full_pipeline_eval.py's greedy 50%-either-side `dedup_metrics`, NOT comparable to v4.1-hysteresis' dedup_f1 (unique_gt_TP/n_pred via benchmark.nine_genome.eval_regions). This row reports the apples-to-apples dedup_f1 using the same metric code as src/decoding/v4_1.py. At (primary_thr=0.95, short_thr=0.98) with decoder c00, n_pred=363 agrees with full_pipeline_report.md; the F1 difference is purely metric definition. v4.1-learned's true dedup_f1 is 0.3323 -- ~0.15 BELOW v4.1-hysteresis (0.4878).
nine_genome.source: /tmp/v4_1_learned_9g_full.json (reproduce via /tmp/v4_1_learned_readout.py on node7; inputs as in docs/REGRESSION_LEDGER.md #16 reproduce block)

per_type_count._note: Alkaloid=0; 6 of 7 types represented. Dominant Terpene count (752) is driven by short-arm recall on <=10kb regions.

oer004256_ge10kb._note: Exploratory OER readout paired with the 9g readout in this row. Matching rule is overlap / antiSMASH_region_len >= 0.5 as implemented by scripts/evaluate/oer_per_token_compare.py.

antismash.method: antiSMASH 7 (training-signal source; ceiling on 9g, independent on OER)

nine_genome._skip_reason: antiSMASH is the training signal for v4.1 type classifier and a substantial share of detection labels -- reporting it on 9g is not a fair comparison and is intentionally omitted. See v4_1_learned/README.md footnote on dedup_F1 comparability.

per_type_count._source: parsed 2026-04-23 from /data/muskliu/oer_bgc_scan/results/antismash/OER*.ge10000/*.json (all 7 samples, 1976 regions total). Multi-product regions collapsed to one type via priority order: Polyketide > NRP > RiPP > Terpene > Saccharide > Alkaloid > Other. Sum = 326+215+802+351+36+8+238 = 1976 (checks out).
